pains.title: Regression automation hits three walls
pains.subtitle: Scripts break when the page changes, agents drift when the context shifts, coverage lags once releases speed up.

items.title: Recorded scripts break on every change
items.desc: Traditional recordings bind to page structure and locators, so a single version change invalidates whole batches of cases. Repairing them often takes longer than re-recording.

items.title: Intent-driven testing: slow and unpredictable
items.desc: Having an agent reason through every step is slow and token-heavy — and the same case can behave differently under a different model or context.

items.title: AI coding accelerates; coverage lags behind
items.desc: Commit frequency is multiplying, but test assets still update by hand — impact never assessed, changes never covered, so regression stays a blind run.

features.title: Built for QA teams

items.title: Exploratory testing
items.desc: Hand the AI a charter and it hunts for trouble in a real browser: persona matrix exploring in parallel, scoped to recent code changes. Defect candidates carry evidence screenshots — confirm one to promote it into a test case.

items.title: Dual-mode replay
items.desc: Two engines in one case: AI-driven replay generalizes across page changes, while mechanical DSL replays run fast and precise — coverage and efficiency, no trade-off.

items.title: AI assistant workspace
items.desc: An AI assistant carries you through case authoring, debugging, execution and root-cause analysis — plain language, end to end.

items.title: Data-driven testing
items.desc: Bind datasets to case parameters — one row, one scenario. Supports multi-turn interaction data such as agent conversations.

items.title: Self-healing cases
items.desc: Cases evolve with the version: mechanical DSL updates itself as the page structure changes. No more manual upkeep.

items.title: Failure root-cause analysis
items.desc: Failures are attributed automatically: pinned to the exact step with a cause category, evidence and a suggested fix — fully traceable in the report.

items.title: Change-scoped exploration
items.desc: Write "the last month of changes" in the charter: the AI resolves the git commit range and the changed files, and can even read the code while exploring — increments never get tested blind.

items.title: PC & mobile coverage
items.desc: Web and iOS/Android in one platform: mobile cases run on simulators, emulators and real devices.
